lede: Wat Don Chai Phra Bat accounts for 41 catalogued manuscripts, 4 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Nan (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (93%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (7%). Dated witnesses run 1760–1934 CE (29 of 41 carry a date).
